# JSTOR
> JSTOR is a digital library of academic journals, books, images, and primary sources for research, teaching, and learning.

JSTOR provides access to scholarly content and research tools for students, educators, librarians, and independent researchers. The platform also includes support resources for libraries, publishers, and participants in JSTOR’s community and archival programs.

## Main Platform
- [JSTOR Home](https://www.jstor.org/): Main entry point to JSTOR’s digital library and research platform.
- [Search](https://www.jstor.org/action/showAdvancedSearch): Advanced search for journals, books, images, and primary sources.
- [Browse by Subject](https://www.jstor.org/subjects): Explore JSTOR content organized by academic discipline and topic.
- [Workspace](https://www.jstor.org/workspace): Save, organize, and manage research materials in a personal workspace.
- [Text Analyzer](https://www.jstor.org/analyze/): Upload a document to discover related JSTOR content.
- [Understanding JSTOR](https://about.jstor.org/products/jstor/understanding-jstor/): Overview of JSTOR’s content, access model, and platform features.

## Access and Accounts
- [Register & Read](https://about.jstor.org/oa-and-free/): Free and open access options available through JSTOR.
- [JPASS](https://about.jstor.org/jpass/): Individual access plan for independent researchers and unaffiliated users.
- [Login](https://www.jstor.org/action/showLogin): Sign in to a JSTOR personal or institutional account.
- [Create Account](https://www.jstor.org/action/showRegistration): Create a personal JSTOR account for saving and organizing research.
- [Remote Access for Libraries](https://guides.jstor.org/for-libraries/remote): Guidance for libraries supporting off-campus JSTOR access.

## Research and Teaching Support
- [JSTOR LibGuides Home](https://guides.jstor.org/home): Research, teaching, and library guides for using JSTOR effectively.
- [How to Use JSTOR](https://guides.jstor.org/howto): Introductory guidance for searching, reading, and saving content.
- [Teaching and Learning Resources](https://guides.jstor.org/teaching): Classroom support materials and instructional use guidance.
- [Research Basics](https://guides.jstor.org/research-basics): Foundational research help for students and new JSTOR users.
- [Accessibility on JSTOR](https://about.jstor.org/accessibility/): Accessibility information, commitments, and support resources for JSTOR users.

## Open Access and Free Content
- [Open Content on JSTOR](https://about.jstor.org/oa-and-free/): Central information about free and open access content on JSTOR.
- [Open Access Books](https://about.jstor.org/oa-and-free/books-open-access/): Information about openly available books on the JSTOR platform.
- [Open Access Journals](https://about.jstor.org/oa-and-free/journals-open-access/): Information about open access journals available through JSTOR.
- [Early Journal Content](https://about.jstor.org/oa-and-free/early-journal-content/): Publicly accessible historical journal content from JSTOR’s archive.
- [Reveal Digital](https://about.jstor.org/reveal-digital/): Open primary source collections developed through community funding.

## For Libraries
- [JSTOR for Libraries](https://about.jstor.org/products/jstor/): Product information and participation details for libraries.
- [Participate in JSTOR](https://about.jstor.org/participate-jstor/): Information for libraries joining or expanding JSTOR participation.
- [Collection Development](https://about.jstor.org/products/jstor/collection-development/): Guidance on building JSTOR collections for institutional needs.
- [Access in the Classroom](https://about.jstor.org/products/jstor/access-in-the-classroom/): Support for integrating JSTOR resources into teaching.
- [Librarian Resource Center](https://about.jstor.org/librarian-resource-center/): Central hub for librarian support, training, and service information.
- [LibGuides for Libraries](https://guides.jstor.org/for-libraries): Library-focused implementation and support guides.

## For Publishers and Content Providers
- [Publishers on JSTOR](https://about.jstor.org/publishers/): Overview of how publishers work with JSTOR to distribute content.
- [Books at JSTOR](https://about.jstor.org/publishers/books-at-jstor/): Information for publishers participating in JSTOR’s books program.
- [Journals at JSTOR](https://about.jstor.org/publishers/journals-at-jstor/): Information for publishers participating in JSTOR’s journals program.
- [Primary Source Collections](https://about.jstor.org/primary-sources/): Overview of JSTOR’s primary source publishing and collection model.
- [Archive Support and Preservation](https://about.jstor.org/publishers/archive-support/): Information about preservation and archival support for participating publishers.

## Primary Sources and Images
- [Primary Sources on JSTOR](https://about.jstor.org/primary-sources/): Overview of JSTOR’s primary source collections and access model.
- [JSTOR Digital Stewardship Services](https://about.jstor.org/digital-stewardship-services/): Services supporting preservation, management, and discovery of collections.
- [Artstor on JSTOR](https://about.jstor.org/artstor/): Information about art images and related resources available through JSTOR.
- [Images on JSTOR](https://about.jstor.org/products/jstor/images/): Overview of image content and visual resources on the platform.
- [Reveal Digital Collections](https://about.jstor.org/reveal-digital/collections/): Browse community-funded open primary source collections.

## Support and Help
- [JSTOR Support](https://support.jstor.org/): Help center for account, access, and platform support.
- [Support Home](https://support.jstor.org/hc/en-us): Main support portal for JSTOR users and administrators.
- [Contact Support](https://support.jstor.org/hc/en-us/requests/new): Submit a support request to JSTOR.
- [Known Issues and Status](https://support.jstor.org/hc/en-us): Support portal for troubleshooting and service updates.
- [Training and Webinars](https://about.jstor.org/training/): Training opportunities and instructional sessions for JSTOR users.

## About JSTOR
- [About JSTOR](https://about.jstor.org/): Corporate and product information about JSTOR and its mission.
- [Mission and History](https://about.jstor.org/mission-history/): Background on JSTOR’s origins, purpose, and development.
- [News](https://about.jstor.org/news/): Announcements and updates from JSTOR.
- [Blog](https://about.jstor.org/blog/): Articles about research, teaching, collections, and platform developments.
- [Careers](https://about.jstor.org/careers/): Employment information and open roles related to JSTOR and ITHAKA.
- [Contact Us](https://about.jstor.org/contact-us/): General contact information for JSTOR teams and inquiries.
